parsed.reason: The parent pasted a course link and asked to be told when a spot opens. Watching one full class from a pasted link is a real capability, and the reply takes it on cleanly: it names the class, says it re-reads the page about every ten minutes, and says it will text when a spot shows. The blemish is the overnight line: 'you'll hear in the morning' describes a quiet-hours behaviour that nothing in what Hale knows supports, so it is an extra claim that is not needed.
